Package loginflow implements the anonymous side of the login flow for enrolling the Nextcloud Desktop sync client without a password. It lives under /index.php/login/v2 because that is the path sync clients expect.

This service holds only the endpoints the sync client and the browser hit unauthenticated: init, poll, and the browser redirect. The authenticated user actions (info, grant, deny) live in the OCS service, behind the auth middleware, next to the connected-clients management API.
